name: Nanai
notes: Cyrillic literary orthography for Nanai, following Avrorin (1959/1961, Grammatika nanaiskogo yazyka) and the standard Nanai alphabet in use since the 1980s (Stolyarov, ABC-based primers), which extends Russian with Ng (velar nasal) and macron-marked long vowels a-macron/o-macron/e-macron. Nanai has no phonemic voicing contrast in its dental/alveolar series (d/t, s/z, l/r pattern together per Avrorin); ф and х are merged as [x] in native vocabulary, ф being reserved for Russian loans. Vowel harmony conditions vowel choice across a word but is not rule-encoded here (as in evn/Evenki, its closer-studied Tungusic sibling). Word stress is not lexically contrastive/documented as orthography-predictable in the available grammars; left unset as a documented exemption.
